claim_one_line: THE OPEN EISENSTEIN CUSP: sL-6's gate passed one level above B1385's nearest miss. S1 (the search): all 183 covers of ocube06_08812 of degree 2 and 3 (7 + 176); 18 carry a rotated cusp, in 8 isometry classes; 7 classes close (6 by an isometry negating the invariant classes, L3; 1 by the cusps' mirrors), and ONE stays open: cube~3.24 (= ~3.80 = ~3.105), o10_150725 -> covers(3)[4] -> covers(3)[24], a degree-9 cover of a member of B1186's family: 90 tetrahedra, volume exactly 45 vol(m004), H1 = Z/3 + Z/3 + Z/9 + Z^5, four cusps (three hexagonal), isometry group D3, all six orientation-preserving (chiral). S3 (B1369's instrument, exact): the order-3 isometry R rotates cusps 0 and 3 and translates cusps 1 and 2; V = H^1(M)^R has dimension 3 (inside ann(P_0) and ann(P_3), L2); the swaps of cusps 0 and 3 act on V with eigenvalues +1, -1, -1; H^1(M)^Isom = <v+> is exactly the cuspidal line (b1 - #cusps = 1), v+ = (1, -1, -1, 0, -2); no isometry negates v+, so neither B1369's parity nor L3 applies. S4 (B1370's instrument unchanged): leading allowed shells of v+ -- cusps 0 and 3 the first hexagonal shell, one rotation orbit (L1: chi = +-1); cusp 1 one direction (annular, 0); cusp 2 the sqrt3-shell (0 or +-3); R's translations kill the shells pairing non-integrally with them. L4 (the fixed-point congruence, proved by Riemann-Hurwitz): if an order-3 isometry fixes the class, chi(d+_c) = #(Fix R in d+_c) mod 3 at a cusp it rotates (three fixed points, all extrema of the invariant field) and 0 mod 3 at a cusp it translates; so N = -sum over rotated cusps of #(Fix in d+) mod 3. T2: N(v+) = #(Fix R in d+_0) mod 3; if the harmonic form's first Fourier coefficient at cusp 0 is non-zero at a phase off L1's six, the fixed points carry 3|c|cos(phi + 2 pi m/3) (sum zero), so N(v+) = chi_0 = +-1 mod 3: never 0 and never +-3; with the leading shells N(v+) in {+-1, +-2, +-5}. Controls: Morse count primary (Newton seeded at the fixed points, refined until complete), grid cross-check where resolved -- the congruence on every regular sample (model torus 120/120; the member's own invariant fields 1439/1439, one degenerate sample excluded and counted), the grid agreeing wherever resolved; without the first shell #Fix in {0, 3} occurs, so the hypothesis matters. The class selects itself twice (the only isometry-fixed line: a fixed point, not a free orbit, B1384; the only cuspidal class: the Higgs field normalisable). Conditional on one analytic coefficient (B1370's residual in kind; here a Fourier coefficient of a weight-2 cusp form for a group commensurable with PSL(2, O3)). Not three: N(v+) is not a multiple of 3. Pullbacks multiply (N(p*v) = deg p N(v)), so a degree-3 cover gives 3N(v+) and a freely permuted triple of cusps is always such a pullback -- 'three' here is B1384's one-versus-three cover-resolution question (sL-5), not a derivation; both shapes registered as new lead sL-7 with that caveat. Fences: the seat's frame (sign partition of the leading cusp mode, the R23-scoped convention), spin-0 half only; the spin-1/2 half and the SM conditions untouched. No physics crossed. 0 of 19.
